caption: The drawing depicts a long-sleeved, knee-length dress with a wide skirt, rendered in a light brown or tan color with subtle crosshatch texture suggesting fabric. The dress features a sailor-style collar and cuffs, both highlighted by white embroidered or printed leafy vine patterns that extend down the front and along the bottom hem of the skirt. The front of the dress, as well as the skirt, are adorned with the same white leafy motif, creating vertical and horizontal lines of decoration. A belt is drawn around the waist, defined by a thin line. Near the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a small sketch of the same dress in plain outline, showing the basic shape and decorative placements without color or detailed pattern. The background is lightly yellowed, resembling aged paper, and the entire image is drawn in a clean, precise manner.
title: Boy's Dress
